options.content: Reads `AUDIT_LOG_FILE`'s JSONL, shipped by Grafana Alloy to Loki. One line per tool call: `timestamp`, `event`, `tool`, `outcome`, `duration_ms`, `sub`, `client_id`, `ip`, `args_hash`, `rows`. Only `event` is a Loki label (bounded); everything else is queried out of the JSON line with `| json` to avoid a high-cardinality stream. The `Client ID` and `Sub` variables are regexes applied after `| json` (Loki cannot enumerate JSON fields); leave them at `.*` for everything.

panels.title: Tool calls over time by outcome
panels.description: Audit lines per 5m bucket, split by outcome. Sourced from Loki, so it survives a server restart that resets the Prometheus counters.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({job="pgllens-audit", event="tool_call"} | json | __error__="" | client_id=~"$client_id" | sub=~"$sub" [5m]))

panels.title: Top clients (24h)
panels.description: Ten busiest OAuth `client_id` values in the last 24h. Absent when auth is off -- unauthenticated calls audit a null client_id.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (client_id) (count_over_time({job="pgllens-audit", event="tool_call"} | json | __error__="" | client_id=~"$client_id" | sub=~"$sub" [24h])))

panels.title: Calls by IP (24h)
panels.description: Twenty busiest source IPs in the last 24h, taken from the audit line's `ip` field (the proxied client address, not the container's).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({job="pgllens-audit", event="tool_call"} | json | __error__="" | client_id=~"$client_id" | sub=~"$sub" [24h])))

panels.title: Recent audit lines
panels.description: The raw JSONL audit trail, newest first. `args_hash` is a salted digest of the call arguments -- it correlates repeats without storing SQL.
